stateDiagram

%% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
%% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
state "." as ROOT.(InitialState)

state MANUAL {

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as MANUAL.(InitialState)

        PowerPoint1

        PowerPoint1 : PowerPoint1

        PowerPoint1 : enter / #123; ResetPowerCalibration()#59; #125;

        PowerPoint2

        PowerPoint2 : PowerPoint2

        PowerPoint2 : enter / #123; StartPowerPoint()#59; #125;

        PowerPoint3

        PowerPoint3 : PowerPoint3

        PowerPoint3 : enter / #123; StartPowerPoint()#59; #125;

        PowerComplete

        PowerComplete : PowerComplete

        PowerComplete : enter / #123; CalculatePowerCurveFit()#59; #125;

        SSBPoint

        SSBPoint : SSBPoint

        SSBPoint : enter / #123; StartSSBPoint()#59; #125;

        MeasurementComplete

        MeasurementComplete : MeasurementComplete

        MeasurementComplete : enter / #123; CalculateSSBPoint()#59; #125;

}

state AUTO {

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as AUTO.(InitialState)

        state POINT {

                %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
                %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
                state "." as POINT.(InitialState)

                KEYDOWN

                KEYDOWN : KEYDOWN

                KEYDOWN : enter / #123; AutoKey()#59; count_ms = 0#59; #125;

                state POINT.(ChoicePoint)() <>

                METER_ENTRY

                METER_ENTRY : METER_ENTRY

                METER_ENTRY : enter / #123; AutoStartMeterEntry()#59; count_ms = 0#59; #125;

                METER_PAUSED

                METER_PAUSED : METER_PAUSED

                METER_PAUSED : enter / #123; AutoUnkey()#59; #125;

                COLLECT

                COLLECT : COLLECT

                COLLECT : enter / #123; AutoStartCollect()#59; count_ms = 0#59; #125;

        }

        state AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() <>

        REST

        REST : REST

        REST : enter / #123; AutoUnkey()#59; count_ms = 0#59; #125;

        FIT_FORWARD

        FIT_FORWARD : FIT_FORWARD

        FIT_FORWARD : enter / #123; AutoUnkey()#59; AutoFitForwardLine()#59; #125;

        BAND_DONE

        BAND_DONE : BAND_DONE

        BAND_DONE : enter / #123; AutoUnkey()#59; AutoFinishBand()#59; #125;

        state AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() <>

        FIT_ALL

        FIT_ALL : FIT_ALL

        FIT_ALL : enter / #123; AutoFitAndCheckAll()#59; #125;

        REVIEW

        REVIEW : REVIEW

        DONE

        DONE : DONE

        SETUP

        SETUP : SETUP

        PROMPT

        PROMPT : PROMPT

        PROMPT : enter / #123; AutoPromptStandard()#59; #125;

        BAND

        BAND : BAND

        BAND : enter / #123; AutoSelectBand()#59; count_ms = 0#59; #125;

        STORE

        STORE : STORE

        STORE : enter / #123; AutoStorePoint()#59; #125;

}

ROOT.(InitialState) --> MANUAL

MANUAL --> PowerPoint1 : RESET

MANUAL --> AUTO : AUTO [AutoCalAllowed()]

MANUAL.(InitialState) --> PowerPoint1

PowerPoint1 --> PowerPoint2 : RECORD_DATA_POINT / #123; RecordPowerDataPoint()#59; #125;

PowerPoint2 --> PowerPoint3 : RECORD_DATA_POINT / #123; RecordPowerDataPoint()#59; #125;

PowerPoint3 --> PowerComplete : RECORD_DATA_POINT / #123; RecordPowerDataPoint()#59; #125;

PowerComplete --> SSBPoint : CURVE_COMPLETE

SSBPoint --> MeasurementComplete : RECORD_DATA_POINT / #123; RecordPowerDataPoint()#59; #125;

AUTO --> MANUAL : RESET

AUTO.(InitialState) --> SETUP

POINT.(InitialState) --> KEYDOWN

KEYDOWN --> POINT.(ChoicePoint)() : do [AutoServiceIdle() && count_ms >= settle_ms]

POINT.(ChoicePoint)() --> METER_ENTRY : [AutoNeedsMeterEntry()]

POINT.(ChoicePoint)() --> COLLECT : else

METER_ENTRY --> COLLECT : RECORD_DATA_POINT

METER_ENTRY --> METER_PAUSED : do [count_ms >= meterTimeout_ms]

METER_PAUSED --> KEYDOWN : RECORD_DATA_POINT

COLLECT --> STORE : do [AutoServiceIdle() && count_ms >= collect_ms]

AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() --> BAND_DONE : 1. [AutoOscillationDetected()] / #123; AutoAbortBandStage()#59; #125;

AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() --> POINT : 2. [AutoMorePoints() && AutoKeepKeyed()]

AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() --> REST : 3. [AutoMorePoints()]

AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() --> FIT_FORWARD : 4. [AutoForwardFitDue()]

AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() --> BAND_DONE : else

REST --> POINT : do [AutoServiceIdle() && count_ms >= rest_ms]

FIT_FORWARD --> POINT : do [AutoServiceIdle()]

BAND_DONE --> AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() : do [AutoServiceIdle()]

AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() --> BAND : 1. [AutoMoreBands()] / #123; AutoNextBand()#59; #125;

AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() --> PROMPT : 2. [AutoMoreStages()] / #123; AutoNextStage()#59; #125;

AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() --> FIT_ALL : else

FIT_ALL --> REVIEW : do [AutoServiceIdle()]

REVIEW --> DONE : RECORD_DATA_POINT / #123; AutoCommitResults()#59; #125;

REVIEW --> SETUP : RETRY [AutoAnyFailed()] / #123; AutoRetryFailed()#59; #125;

SETUP --> PROMPT : RECORD_DATA_POINT / #123; AutoBeginSession()#59; #125;

PROMPT --> BAND : RECORD_DATA_POINT / #123; AutoFirstBand()#59; #125;

PROMPT --> PROMPT : SKIP [AutoCanSkipStage()] / #123; AutoSkipStage()#59; #125;

BAND --> POINT : do [AutoServiceIdle() && count_ms >= bandSettle_ms]

STORE --> AUTO.(ChoicePoint)() : do [AutoServiceIdle()]
